sections.heading: A website for your group, built the same day you register
sections.lead: Once your group or MSME is registered through CECF, it gets a free public page on Our Jamii — a place people can find you, read what you do, and support a fundraising campaign directly, without you needing to build or pay for a website yourself.

body: Our Jamii is built and run by Esoqo, CECF's digital-platform partner for registration and formalisation. It is not a separate signup — every group that comes through CECF's registration already has an Esoqo account, and Our Jamii is switched on from the same one.

sections.heading: One page, everything a supporter needs

items.title: A public page with your own web address
items.body: Who you are, what you do, your leadership and your work — written by your own team, editable any time from your dashboard.

items.title: Fundraising campaigns with M-Pesa
items.body: Set a goal, publish a campaign, and let people give straight from their phone. Every gift is receipted and reconciled automatically.

items.title: Members, updates and a contact form
items.body: Post news, list your programs, show your gallery, and let people reach you without publishing a personal phone number.

sections.heading: Built on the same registration you already did
prose: There is nothing extra to fill in. The name, leadership and location CECF captured when your group registered is what your Our Jamii page starts from — your team only ever adds to it, never re-enters it.

Every donation your page receives is posted to the same ledger and receipt system Esoqo already uses for registration fees and group contributions, so a gift to your campaign is accounted for exactly as carefully as any other money moving through your group's account.

media.alt: A community group meeting under a tree

sections.body: Free for every CECF-registered group and MSME. There is no separate charge to have a page or to run a campaign — Esoqo's own transaction fees apply only to money actually raised, the same standard M-Pesa charges you would pay collecting the same money any other way.

sections.heading: See a real group's page
sections.body: Browse live Our Jamii pages from groups already registered through CECF, or open your own group's dashboard if you have already registered.
